spans.s:
m. (-र्त्तः)
A fisherman born of a prostitute by a Kṣatriya, or of an Ayogava female by a Niṣāda father.
f. (-र्त्ती)
The wife of a fisherman.
E.
क water, in the seventh case, के and वर्त्त who abides, केवर्त्त a fish, अण् affix, implying enmity.

n. (-कं)
A fragrant grass: see the next.

n. (-कं)
A fragrant kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus).
E.
कैवर्त्त as above, water-abiding, and मुस्तक cyperus; also कैवर्त्तीमुस्तक, कैवर्त्तंमुस्त, &c.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ली-ल्यं)
Sole, only.
n. (-ल्यं)
1 Eternal emancipation, future happiness.
2 Exclusiveness, individuality.
E.
केवल alone, free from all fetters, व्यञ् affix of the abstract.
